marketing_hero_title: Launch your AI product in days, not months
marketing_hero_subtitle: Accounts, billing, credits, AI features, admin and a multilingual marketing site — ready to rebrand and ship.
marketing_features_title: Everything a paid AI app needs
marketing_features_subtitle: The boring parts are done, so you can focus on what makes your product different.
marketing_feature_auth_body: Email, one-time codes and social sign-in, with personal and team workspaces.
marketing_feature_billing_body: Plans, credit packs and an auditable credit ledger with more than one payment provider.
marketing_feature_ai_body: Streaming chat, image and video generation, billed by actual usage.
marketing_feature_i18n_body: Every page, email and error message in the languages you configure.
marketing_feature_admin_body: Users, billing, refunds and model pricing in one place.
marketing_feature_content_body: Write posts, legal pages and documentation as MDX files in the repository.
marketing_pricing_subtitle: Start free, upgrade when you need more credits.
marketing_faq_1_a: Credits are the unit used to pay for AI features. Each request costs credits based on the model and how much it generates.
marketing_faq_2_q: Can I cancel at any time?
marketing_faq_2_a: Yes. Cancelling stops the next renewal and you keep your plan until the end of the current period.
marketing_faq_3_a: Payments are not refunded by default, but you can request a refund from the billing page. See the refund policy for details.
marketing_faq_4_a: The site, emails and error messages are available in every language configured for this site.
marketing_testimonial_1_quote: We replaced weeks of setup with an afternoon of copy changes.
marketing_testimonial_2_quote: Credits and refunds just work, and the ledger makes support easy.
marketing_testimonial_3_quote: Shipping in two languages from day one was a nice surprise.
marketing_cta_body: Create a free account and try the AI features with your welcome credits.
marketing_legal_english_only: This page is currently available in English only.
pricing_intro: Every chart, calculator and tarot spread on this site is free. Credits are only for full AI readings — an in-depth written interpretation of your own chart or cards.
pricing_payments_soon: Online payment is coming soon. You can use all free tools now; credit packs will be available to buy shortly.
pricing_pack_expiry: Credits are valid for {days} days after purchase.
pricing_unlock_title: Full readings you can unlock here
pricing_unlock_note: Each full reading uses {credits} credits. Run the free tool first, then choose “Unlock the full reading” under your result.
pricing_faq_free_a: All charts, calculators, card meanings and tarot spreads, with their standard results. No account is needed.
pricing_faq_fail_a: If a full reading fails or is incomplete, it is marked as failed and your credits are returned automatically, so you can try again.
pricing_faq_refund_a: Unused credits can be refunded on request within {days} days of purchase. See the Refund Policy for details.
pricing_faq_accuracy_a: No. Calculations follow the rules of each system; interpretations are for entertainment and self-reflection, not predictions or professional advice.
pricing_faq_pay_a: Payments will be processed securely by our payment provider. We never see or store your card details.
